{{Quote|One command from me and the electrical net renders both of you unconscious.|[[Drez Unlin]], to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]|<ref name="The Masked Racer">{{SWComicCite|7.3|The Masked Racer}}</ref>}}
'''Electroshock nets''', also referred to as '''electro-nets''' or '''electro nets''', were an advanced design of the primitive [[Net/Legends|net]]. Able to be set to stun on impact or upon receiving a remote signal, these weapons consisted of several miniaturized [[Power cell/Legends|power packs]] and stunning filaments. The typical remote signal had a strength of 40 meters. The power packs were depleted after releasing a single charge. It was once used on [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Darsha Assant]], [[Lorn Pavan]], his companion [[I-5YQ]], and the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] by the cannibalistic humanoids [[Cthon/Legends|Cthons]] in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]].
